product_metadata.title: VASAGLE Corner Shelf Stand, 4-Tier Corner Bookshelf, Industrial Corner Ladder Shelf, Plant Stand Display Shelf for Living Room, Office, Kitchen, Rustic Dark Brown and Black ULLS34BF
features: [A Shelf for Every Room] Fill an empty corner in your living room, use it as a corner plant stand in the study for greenery, or nestle it in the entryway, dining room, or bedroom...this corner shelf stand can come into full play
[Maximize Your Corner Space] With a 13.4”D x 13.4”W x 49.2”H size, this 4-tier display shelf lets you make full use of a corner space to house decorations, books, picture frames, and more
[Assembly Done in a Jiff] Thanks to the clear instructions, labeled parts, and pre-drilled holes in the metal tubes for effortlessly fitting screws in, you'll set up this corner bookshelf in no time
[Stability, Checked] With a 3-legged structure (one has an adjustable foot), this corner shelf unit can stand stably on your floor and fits well against the wall; an anti-tip fit ensures safe use
[Serves Good Style] Invite industrial vibes in with its rustic brown shelves and black metal frame; this corner shelving unit will give a style lift to any home looking for decoration or renovation
